0022600111.text: The Warriors (0-2) are looking for their first win after two straight losses, sitting 13th in the West and 2 games back in the Pacific, while the 0-1 Suns sit 15th in the West. Golden State is missing Charles Bassey, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody, and Phoenix is without Mark Williams, with Luke Kennard and Oso Ighodaro listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Warriors won 3-1 against the Suns in 2025-26, including a 101-97 road win in Phoenix on February 5, 2026.
